description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/latlon3d/rules/ppm_flux_D_lev_mono_hybrid_noflux_bc -- the TERRAIN-FOLLOWING (hybrid sigma-pressure) upwind-biased, monotone, conservative flux-form vertical advection operator. Pinned here: (1) MASS FORM -- the operator is the RAW face-flux difference F_{k+1/2} - F_{k-1/2} with NO division by a cell thickness (the fixed-grid golden divides by dz[.,.,k]); this is what keeps the vertical divergence conservative when the layers move. (2) TERRAIN-FOLLOWING RECONSTRUCTION -- the CW84 parabola widths are gathered from the RANK-3 physical thickness dp[i,j,k+/-n] (the grid's lev_thickness_3d applied to a 3-D pe = Ap + Bp*Ps), not a 1-D column dz[k]. (3) THREE REGIONS -- the interior levels k = 4..NLEV-3 are stencils/ppmflux_D_lev_hyb_interior (window read by plain offsets) and the two three-level slabs next to the ground (k = 1..3, stencils/ppmflux_D_lev_hyb_nf_bottom) and the model top (k = NLEV-2..NLEV, stencils/ppmflux_D_lev_hyb_nf_top) read the window edge-extended by clamped subscripts (max(k-3,1), ..., min(k+3,NLEV)), with the ground and model-top wall fluxes selected to zero (ifelse(k > 1, F_{k-1/2}, 0), ifelse(k < NLEV, F_{k+1/2}, 0)). The compound match D(W*q, wrt: lev) fires at priority 10 with the branch-free max/min upwind donor selection. NLEV = 7 exercises a one-level interior and every edge-extended window member.
